scope: One focused test-first regression for held successful synthetic login with a distinct newer email draft and route away/reentry. The expected emitted login tree must use authenticated identity A after success. No product code may change until the expected RED is observed.
expected_red: The synthetic account registers and is approved; exactly one held login request is made for email A; the draft changes to B; navigation goes away and back before release; login succeeds with runtime/session authority A and controller loginDraft cleared to null; route remains login; ephemeral password is absent from inspected surfaces. The final assertion on the emitted tree expects A and should fail on current behavior by observing B.
red_command: --test-name-pattern=held successful login projects authenticated email after route reentry
run_policy: One red invocation only. Capture original stdout/stderr byte-for-byte, UTC start/end, and exit code. If red is not the predeclared tree assertion after all preceding checks, stop without changing product code or silently weakening assertions.
